trials.why: This completed trial compared dutasteride and finasteride against placebo for androgenetic alopecia (hair count at vertex). Dutasteride 0.5 mg showed the largest effect: LS mean difference of 94.4 hairs vs placebo (p<0.001, 98.33% CI: 67.8–121.0). Finasteride 1 mg showed a smaller but still significant effect: LS mean difference of 61.4 hairs vs placebo (p<0.001, 98.33% CI: 34.4–88.4). Even the lowest dutasteride dose (0.02 mg) showed a trend vs placebo (difference 22, p=0.046, though CI crossed zero: -4.4–48.4). All active treatments improved hair count significantly over placebo, with dutasteride 0.5 mg superior to finasteride. The trial measured the requested endpoint (androgenetic alopecia via hair count) and demonstrated clear benefit of the SRD5A2 inhibitors over placebo.
